response.rationale: Skin biopsy shows langerin-positive dermal infiltrate, diagnostic of Langerhans cell histiocytosis; BRAF-V600E supports clonal neoplastic nature. MDS history is background, not the presenting lesion.

rejected.why: Describes underlying MDS, not the current skin lesion.
Subtype of MDS, unrelated to the langerin-positive infiltrate.
BRAF-V600E is a molecular feature, not a specific diagnosis; LCH is the specific entity.
Overly broad genetic descriptor, lacks the langerin-positive histologic specificity.
